name: Circadian Entrainment
description: Light-mediated synchronization of the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) to 24-hour solar cycle. Neural mechanism well-understood (melanopsin→SCN); debate centers on whether this counts as a T1 computational primitive or a specialized system.
key_references: Moore, R. Y. (1997). Circadian rhythms: Basic neurobiology and clinical applications. Annual Review of Medicine, 48, 253-266.
Lucas, R. J., Peirson, S. N., Berson, D. M., et al. (2014). Measuring and using light in the melanopsin age. Trends in Neurosciences, 37(1), 1-9.
empirical_evidence: Melanopsin-expressing retinal ganglion cells project to SCN; this circuit phototransduces light to circadian phase adjustment. Functional circuitry clear. Status as T1 atom debated: is it a primitive computation (phase adjustment) or a specialized hierarchical system? Could argue either way.
